rca of the issue: Startup handler in server.py referenced a background task function (_inactivity_reminder_loop) that was never implemented - an abandoned half-built feature. Every uvicorn boot raised NameError inside starlette's lifespan startup, preventing the app from serving traffic. Fix: removed the single `asyncio.create_task(_inactivity_reminder_loop())` line; _progression_alert_loop task still starts.
